# Transformers Mission 05: Decoder Block
#
# The decoder block is more complex than the encoder.
# It has THREE sub-layers instead of two:
#   1. Masked self-attention (can't see future tokens)
#   2. Cross-attention (attends to encoder output)
#   3. Feed-forward network
#
# The causal mask prevents the decoder from "cheating"
# by looking at tokens it hasn't generated yet.
#
# Your goal: Implement decoder_block(x, enc_output, W_q1, W_k1, W_v1, W_o1,
#                                     W_q2, W_k2, W_v2, W_o2,
#                                     W_ff1, W_ff2, num_heads)
#   1. Create causal mask (upper triangle = -1e9)
#   2. Masked self-attention: attn1 = multi_head_attention with mask
#   3. Residual + norm: x1 = layer_norm(x + attn1)
#   4. Cross-attention: attn2 = cross-attend x1 to enc_output
#   5. Residual + norm: x2 = layer_norm(x1 + attn2)
#   6. FFN + residual + norm

import numpy as np

def layer_norm(x, eps=1e-5):
    mean = np.mean(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    std = np.std(x, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return (x - mean) / (std + eps)
